notablePrerequisites: You control at least two nontoken Humans.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing all nontoken Humans, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Angel of Glory's Rise.
Angel of Glory's Rise enters the battlefield, exiling all Zombies and returning all Humans from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
